sources.title: Models & Pricing
sources.notes: Living page. As seen on 2026-10-02: model deepseek-flash = DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and deepseek-v4-pro = DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813, both with thinking and non-thinking modes, 1M context length, 384K maximum output and tool calls; vision supported on deepseek-flash only. Footnote 1: the legacy names deepseek-v4-flash and deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp are still accepted, but their models are retired and requests are served by DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash.
